title: Payoff Quote, Refund and Title Release Timing Schedule — Kestrel Advantage Balloon
content:
The payoff and title figures of the Kestrel Advantage Balloon Retail Installment Sale Contract are the same on every tier. They set how long a payoff quote is honoured, when a credit balance is refunded automatically, the hold on a lien release after payoff by personal check or ACH, and the release and mailing times for electronic and paper titles.

| | Tier 5 | Tier 4 | Tier 3 | Tier 2 | Tier 1 | Tier 1+ |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Calendar days after the quote date through which a payoff quote is honoured | 10 | 10 | 10 | 10 | 10 | 10 |
| Credit balance at or above which a refund is issued automatically (USD) | 1.00 | 1.00 | 1.00 | 1.00 | 1.00 | 1.00 |
| Calendar days within which an automatic overpayment refund is mailed | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 |
| Business days after payoff by personal check or ACH before the lien may be released | 10 | 10 | 10 | 10 | 10 | 10 |
| Business days to release an electronic lien once release is permissible | 3 | 3 | 3 | 3 | 3 | 3 |
| Business days to mail a paper title once release is permissible | 10 | 10 | 10 | 10 | 10 | 10 |

## Notes

- Business days in this schedule are counted as the lien release rule counts them; calendar days are calendar days.
- *Hypothetical illustration:* a credit balance of USD 0.80 is below the automatic refund figure of USD 1.00.
